text.en: A quick revision of the main ideas of Tamil grammar.

இலக்கணம் - பொது is a general grammar section that revises the five parts of Tamil grammar: எழுத்து, சொல், பொருள், யாப்பு and அணி. It helps you connect letters, words, meaning, verse and figures of speech.
The section gives examples and exercises so that you can recall earlier lessons and apply them to reading and writing.
Make a chart of the five parts with one example each, and revise earlier rules such as the types of words, sandhi and phrases.
